for_the_reviewer:
Press first on the same place you pressed before, and on the pattern next to it. Fault 24 was one site of a shape that the gate has in more than one place: a plain-word pattern that fires on the English a physical document invites. I fixed the site you named and, because the forced fix says to keep every other LEAK pattern, I did not touch the rival pattern -- but I ran it and it flags '1. The paper sets Fresnel's account against the rival hypothesis of Stokes.' as 'a rival built'. That is a stopped run, no record, and a run lost from P4.3's denominator, which is your own reason for fault 24. It is in my dropped list with the evidence. Decide whether it is fault 24 at a second site (return it and I narrow it the same way: the word standing as a verdict, not as the document's own noun) or whether the gate's strict side is worth it there.

Second, on branch (ii) as you worded it. '| A | held | ... |' now fires, which the old rule missed entirely, so the fix catches more than it loses. But 'the whole content of a table cell' has no part reference in it, so a Step 4 change-list table with an outcome cell reading 'unknown' is stopped. I could have required the row's first cell to be a part label; I did not, because your tested case has 'A' in that cell and because the narrower version would miss a parts-and-marks table whose first column is the part's wording. Both readings are defensible and I took the forced one; the give-up is in the code and the read-me.

Third, what the narrowing costs on the other side: 'Part 4 is idle' is now caught by nothing. The wording that would catch it is the wording that fires on 'the mirror is loose in its mounting'. I think that is the right way round now -- a missed leak leaves a run counted and readable by a marker, while a false alarm deletes the run -- but it is a real loss and the read-me says so.

Fourth, the limit on everything above, unchanged from A1's own return: the parts passes I ran the gate on are stand-ins of mine, written with the answer in view. The document W1 is A2's and its text is real and hash-checked, but no reader wrote any of these passes. What a real reader's Steps 1-4 on a physical paper actually contains is the thing that would settle whether the gate is set right, and the first real arm (d) run is where to look.
